g.text: rsync.exe and ssh.exe share memory instead of a pipe: a fifth of a push's work, gone
Both processes' processor time over the same 4.3 GB file, divided by the bytes moved; dots are the individual runs, which alternated
transports so the laptop's thermal drift lands on both. One binary either way — RSYNC_WIN32_NO_SHMPIPE=1 keeps the pipes.
Windows: Dell Latitude 7490, i5-8350U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W) · Linux: Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U · Thunderbolt networking, MTU 65330, link 20 Gbit/s

rsync 3.5.0 Windows port, github.com/nuket/rsync-windows · 4.3 GB transfers, aes128-gcm, source file warm in the page cache · kernel pipe = a8664bae, shared-memory ring = 3e660145 · © 2026 Max Vilimpoc
